635:t_021:3.en:
$$カズミ$$
「A source of gravitational anomalies... Should we call it a $$変動重力源$$...?」

635:t_021:4.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I can't believe such $$宇宙怪獣$$ exist...!」

635:t_021:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The trace is complete. Those $$宇宙怪獣$$ we should call $$変動重力源$$s appear to have been transported from Saturn's moon $$タイタン$$.」

635:t_022:0.en:
$$チコ$$
「That $$バスターマシン$$...! It's the 《$$サーペンタイン姉妹$$》' $$カランドゥ$$!」

635:t_022:2.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「We were teleported here too by the power of that eternal $$トップレス$$.」

635:t_022:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Are you talking about the $$変動重力源$$!?」

635:t_022:5.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「So that monster really is the $$タイタンガニ$$ buried on $$タイタン$$.」

635:t_022:7.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「They were excavating it on $$タイタン$$ as an alien $$バスターマシン$$.」

635:t_022:8.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「But the $$サーペンタイン姉妹$$ were eating its flesh to gain eternal $$トップレス$$ powers...」

635:t_022:9.en:
$$チコ$$
「Does doing that actually accomplish anything!?」

635:t_022:10.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「That isn't a $$バスターマシン$$. It's a $$トップレス$$ that has lived for over ten thousand years.」

635:t_022:11.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「With its power, we too can be $$トップレス$$ forever and always stay together.」

635:t_024:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「What... fools... A monster like that could never be an eternal $$トップレス$$...!」

635:t_024:4.en:
$$チコ$$
「What is that power...!? It's on a completely different scale from the other $$宇宙怪獣$$!」

635:t_024:5.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I can't believe something like that was in the Solar System...!」

635:t_024:6.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Who cares where it came from!? Right now, we need to think about beating it!」

635:t_024:7.en:
$$マリ$$
「You make it sound easy, but that thing's a little beyond normal!」

635:t_024:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If the enemy isn't normal, we'll simply use an approach that isn't normal either.」

635:t_024:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$シモン$$! Thanks to the repeated distortions of the dimensional boundary, I've analyzed a point of contact with another dimension!」

635:t_024:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now, with the $$ソーラリアン$$'s event control...」

635:t_024:12.en:
$$シモン$$
「Like hell we've got time for something that slow! Send me the coordinates!」

635:t_024:14.en:
$$トライア$$
「The boss is ready to act. Stop fussing and give him what he wants.」

635:t_026:0.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「You know what you're doing, $$シモン$$!?」

635:t_026:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「It's the same method I used when I sensed $$ニア$$ in the $$アンチスパイラル$$'s universe! I've got the knack!」

635:t_026:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「Hang on, $$ニア$$! My drill's gonna punch right through the dimensional wall now!!」

635:t_027:0.en:
$$チコ$$
「No way! A hole opened in the dimensional boundary!」

635:t_027:2.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「W-What's going to happen!?」

635:t_027:3.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「W-What's going to happen!?」

635:t_027:4.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「This is your first time seeing it, isn't it?」

635:t_027:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「This is our $$大グレン団$$ flagship! The $$超銀河ダイグレン$$!!」

635:t_028:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「I kept you waiting, $$ニア$$! I've come to get you!!」

635:t_028:2.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「All right! We've returned to normal space!」

635:t_028:3.en:
$$リーロン$$
「When $$サイデリアル$$ captured us, I wondered what would happen, but things do work out somehow.」

635:t_028:4.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Heh... Though none of us ever despaired.」

635:t_028:5.en:
$$ニア$$
「We knew $$シモン$$ and everyone in $c would come to save us.」

635:t_028:6.en:
$$ガバル$$
「But it looks like we're suddenly in a hell of a battle!」

635:t_028:7.en:
$$シベラ$$
「There are $$宇宙怪獣$$ we've never seen, and masses of metal...!」

635:t_028:8.en:
$$テツカン$$
「Looks like we've come out somewhere pretty crazy...」

635:t_028:9.en:
$$アーテンボロー$$
「Then we'll just have to shoot like mad!」

635:t_028:11.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Are we doing it, $$シモン$$!?」

635:t_030:0.en:
$$ラルク$$
「The supergiant battleship combined with $$グレンラガン$$ and transformed into a supergiant robot!」

635:t_030:2.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Your sunglasses transformed too, $$シモン$$!」

635:t_030:3.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Your sunglasses transformed too, $$シモン$$!」

635:t_030:4.en:
$$シモン$$
「This is $$超銀河グレンラガン$$! The $$大グレン団$$'s trump card!!」

635:t_030:5.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Now that's more like it! This kind of crazy stuff is always welcome!」

635:t_030:6.en:
$$シルヴィア$$
「To think we'd be saying what everyone always says to us!」

635:t_030:7.en:
$$隼人$$
「But with this power, we can fight even $$宇宙怪獣$$ that have swallowed black holes!」

635:t_030:8.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Let's beat that thing fast so they can start their dialogue with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$!」

635:t_030:10.en:
$$シモン$$
「Yeah! Our target's the black hole space monster!」

635:t_030:12.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「Once we beat that thing...!」

635:t_030:13.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「Once we beat that thing...!」

635:t_030:16.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, concentrate your attacks on the $$変動重力源$$! We must defeat it so we can have dialogue with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$!」
